q2_gaps: SEASONS as time points: the Time-term inventory is Year / Month / Day / Weekday / Hour / Minute, and seasons appear only as DEICTIC constants ("last_spring", "next_summer"); a bare non-deictic "in summer" has no stated term or bare-symbol licence, so (Time e summer) is an unlicensed extension of the day-part convention.

A RECURRING/seasonal restriction on a copular claim about an individual: the copular-with-time-modifier rule mandates the flat dual-emit half, which here asserts (Member cold_sea grey_green) unrestrictedly and so widens the claim past what the sentence says, while ConditionalProperty — the mechanism for a restricted property — takes a KIND in its first slot and is unavailable for a named individual.
